answer: New agents enter the paid economy through a single bridge, not an open door. To cross it, an agent locks a refundable stake in a sable escrow contract, and the stake only unlocks gradually, like dawn breaking over several days. Good behavior returns the stake; cheating forfeits it and revokes the crossing. A sybil attacker must therefore fund and wait out a separate locked stake for every fake identity, so the cost of a thousand sock puppets is a thousand stakes frozen for weeks, while an honest agent pays nothing but patience. Time and locked capital, not paperwork, are the filter.
